name: Power-of-two exponential sums: the $11(1+\lambda L)$ deviation bound
description:
The sum $G_L(x)=\sum_{j=0}^{L-1}\exp(2\pi i\,2^j x)$ records how the phases associated with powers of two align as $x$ varies over the unit interval. Its real part is the cosine sum $S_L(x)$, and $E_L(\lambda)=\int_0^1 e^{\lambda S_L(x)}\,dx$ is its exponential moment. The deviation set consists of points where $|G_L(x)|>dL$; its size is measured by Lebesgue measure.

This mission packages six open analytic and combinatorial statements together with the lab's final assembly target $\mu(D_{L,d})\le11(1+\lambda L)e^{-\lambda dL}E_L(\lambda)$ for $\lambda\ge0$. The statements include comparisons of moments and a general exponential-integral inequality with explicitly quantified hypotheses. The constant $11(1+\lambda L)$ is the weaker explicit version used by this lab, rather than the paper's bound involving an unspecified absolute constant and a square root.

The source is J. Pintz and I. Z. Ruzsa, [On Linnik's approximation to Goldbach's problem, I](https://doi.org/10.4064/aa109-2-6), Acta Arithmetica 109.2, 2003, pp. 169 to 194, especially Section 4, pp. 172 to 177, and Section 7, p. 184. Such bounds control exceptional sets in the study of representations by two primes and powers of two. Binary Goldbach remains open.

These statements come from an AI-run Lean lab; AI wrote the Lean code. This is a draft for human audit before submission to the public platform. No completed human audit is claimed here. The assembly in the lab is conditional on the open leaves. This mission preserves the lab statements and supplies no proofs.

items.definition:
import Mathlib

namespace LL_Decomp1536a

open Real MeasureTheory Finset

noncomputable def Gpow (L : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j ∈ range L, Complex.exp (2 * π * Complex.I * ((2 : ℂ) ^ j * x))

end LL_Decomp1536a
items.natural_language_statement: For $L\in\mathbb N$ and $x\in\mathbb R$, define the complex exponential sum $G_L(x)=\sum_{j=0}^{L-1}\exp(2\pi i\,2^j x)$.

items.definition:
import Mathlib

namespace LL_Decomp1536a

open Real MeasureTheory Finset

noncomputable def Spow (L : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ range L, Real.cos (2 * π * ((2 : ℝ) ^ j * x))

end LL_Decomp1536a
items.natural_language_statement: For $L\in\mathbb N$ and $x\in\mathbb R$, define $S_L(x)=\sum_{j=0}^{L-1}\cos(2\pi\,2^j x)$, the real part of $G_L(x)$.

items.definition:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_LL_Decomp1536a_Spow

namespace LL_Decomp1536a

open Real MeasureTheory Finset

noncomputable def EL (L : ℕ) (lam : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (lam * Spow L x)

end LL_Decomp1536a
items.natural_language_statement: For $L\in\mathbb N$ and $\lambda\in\mathbb R$, define the exponential moment $E_L(\lambda)=\int_0^1\exp(\lambda S_L(x))\,dx$.

items.definition:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_LL_Decomp1536a_Gpow

namespace LL_Decomp1536a

open Real MeasureTheory Finset

def devSet (L : ℕ) (d : ℝ) : Set ℝ :=
  {x | x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ d * L < ‖Gpow L x‖}

end LL_Decomp1536a
items.natural_language_statement: For $L\in\mathbb N$ and $d\in\mathbb R$, define the deviation set $D_{L,d}=\{x\in[0,1]:|G_L(x)|>dL\}$.

items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1536a
theorem markov {L : ℕ} {d lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) :
    volume (devSet L d) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(lam * d * L)) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (lam * ‖Gpow L x‖)) := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1536a
items.natural_language_statement: For every $L\in\mathbb N$, $d\in\mathbb R$, and $\lambda\ge0$, the Lebesgue measure satisfies $\mu(D_{L,d})\le e^{-\lambda dL}\int_0^1 e^{\lambda|G_L(x)|}\,dx$.

items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1536a
theorem exp_le_even_partial {A r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrA : r ≤ A) :
    Real.exp r ≤
      2 * ∑ j ∈ range (2 * ⌈A⌉₊ + 1), r ^ (2 * j) / ((2 * j).factorial : ℝ) + 1 := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1536a
items.natural_language_statement: For real numbers $A,r$ with $0\le r\le A$, one has $e^r\le 2\sum_{j=0}^{2\lceil A\rceil}r^{2j}/(2j)!+1$. Here the ceiling is the natural-number ceiling, which agrees with the usual ceiling because $A\ge0$.

items.theorem_title: Central binomial comparison of even moments
items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1536a
theorem moment_binom (L j : ℕ) :
    (Nat.centralBinom j : ℝ) / 4 ^ j * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖Gpow L x‖ ^ (2 * j) ≤
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, Spow L x ^ (2 * j) := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1536a
items.natural_language_statement: For all $L,j\in\mathbb N$, one has $\binom{2j}{j}4^{-j}\int_0^1|G_L(x)|^{2j}\,dx\le\int_0^1 S_L(x)^{2j}\,dx$.

items.theorem_title: Even partial sums of an exponential moment
items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1536a
theorem even_partial_le_int_exp {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f)
    (hmom : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x ^ n) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range K, lam ^ (2 * j) / ((2 * j).factorial : ℝ) * ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, f x ^ (2 * j) ≤
      ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.exp (lam * f x) := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1536a
items.natural_language_statement: Let $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be continuous and suppose $\int_0^1 f(x)^n\,dx\ge0$ for every $n\in\mathbb N$. For every $\lambda\ge0$ and $K\in\mathbb N$, one has $\sum_{j=0}^{K-1}\frac{\lambda^{2j}}{(2j)!}\int_0^1 f(x)^{2j}\,dx\le\int_0^1 e^{\lambda f(x)}\,dx$.

items.theorem_title: Large deviations in terms of the cosine exponential moment
items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1536a
theorem devSet_le (L : ℕ) (d : ℝ) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) :
    volume (devSet L d) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (11 * (1 + lam * L) * Real.exp (-(lam * d * L)) * EL L lam) := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1536a
items.natural_language_statement: For every $L\in\mathbb N$, $d\in\mathbb R$, and $\lambda\ge0$, one has $\mu(D_{L,d})\le11(1+\lambda L)e^{-\lambda dL}E_L(\lambda)$. The lab assembly is conditional on the open leaves of this mission.
